subject: Kickoff: EMCAPSNet viability study for pose-sensitive matching
body:
Hi Bruno, Yara,

Kickoff for the EMCAPSNet study. Motivation: graphs-retrieval keeps hitting viewpoint sensitivity in visual matching - the same object from a new angle tanks retrieval quality. Capsules with EM routing are explicitly built for viewpoint robustness, and our open-source release ships the model with smallNORB training and eval.

This is a viability study, not a committed product: I want a clear yes/no by early July on whether capsule routing earns a place in the matching stack.

Milestones for Mar 9 - Jul 6: M1 (Apr 10) repro the released checkpoints - the README's eval flow should give 1.8 test error on smallNORB, and 1.3 with patching enabled. M2 (May 22) viewpoint-robustness comparison vs. our CNN baseline under held-out azimuth/elevation splits. M3 (late June) scale stress-test: does EM routing's cost stay sane beyond smallNORB-sized inputs? Then the yes/no memo.

Yara is TL. Bruno: staffing + the June compute ask.

Anders
